title: Jean-Luc Melenchon remarks targeting Haddad on his appointment (September 2024)
description: Shortly after Haddad's September 2024 appointment as Minister Delegate for Europe, La France insoumise founder Jean-Luc Melenchon published remarks stating the new Europe minister was 'aligned with Netanyahu's policy'. The comments drew accusations that they carried antisemitic insinuations about Haddad, who is from a Sephardic Jewish family; former ambassador Gerard Araud and others condemned the remarks. In this episode Haddad is the target of the controversy, not the author of any wrongdoing; no legal proceedings against Haddad arise from it. Presumption of innocence applies to all parties.
status: Public political dispute; Haddad was the subject of criticism, not accused of any offence. No legal action against Haddad.
key_facts: Triggered by Melenchon's reaction to Haddad's nomination as Europe minister in September 2024.
Melenchon characterised Haddad as aligned with Netanyahu's policy.
Critics, including former diplomat Gerard Araud, said the remarks carried antisemitic undertones given Haddad's Jewish background.
Haddad is the target of the remarks; he is not accused of any wrongdoing.

title: Criticism of Haddad's call to tighten EU migration policy
description: On taking office, Haddad called for the European Union to tighten its migration and immigration guidelines and stated he opposes 'massive regularisations', supporting only 'chosen, economic immigration'. The stance drew criticism from left-wing and pro-migrant voices who viewed it as a hardening of France's position, while supporters framed it as responding to citizen demand. This is a policy debate, not an allegation of misconduct.
status: Policy debate; no allegation of wrongdoing or legal proceedings.
key_facts: Haddad advocated tougher EU migration rules after his September 2024 appointment.
He said he favours 'chosen, economic immigration' but opposes 'massive regularisations'.
The position was contested by left-leaning critics as a rightward shift on migration.
